text:
Maya: Quick poll — I'm heading to the co-op in ~20. Want kombucha (GT/Jun), a scone, or anything else? Fridge has mystery hummus situation so I'm bringing containers.
Ravi: Ooh kombucha please (Ginger). Can you also grab oat milk? We're low. :pray:
Sam: Scone for me, almond if they have it. And FYI there's a lone jar labeled "maybe chutney?" in the back of the fridge. :thinking_face:
Devon: I'll take whatever kombucha you like. Also can we get some small disposable containers? People keep leaving tangy things unsealed. :nauseated_face:
Priya: 2x decaf please. I'll drop $6 in the snack fund envelope on my way out. :dollar:
Maya: noted — 1 ginger GT, 1 random kombucha, 1 scone almond, 2 decaf. Containers added. Anyone want the chutney jar? I can put a sticky note.
kitchen-bot: Reminder — snack fund balance: $34.20. To add funds: /snack add <amount>.
Ravi: I'll take the chutney if it's actually chutney. If hummus, pass. :eyes:
Sam: Can someone please bring a permanent marker for labels? I keep finding salads named "Sam's mix?" that are not mine. :sweat_smile:
Devon: I'll bring a pack of 50 labels from home tomorrow. Also can we start a one-line fridge rule in #kitchen-guidelines? Tiny sticky?
Priya: Love the label idea. Maybe a magnet whiteboard for per-shelf notes.
Maya: Cool — I'll buy labels today and stick them by the markers. If you want the chutney, Ravi, leave a note on it so everyone knows.
Ravi: Will do. Thanks Maya! If anyone else wants something from the co-op shout now, leaving in 10.
Sam: Also, FYI — espresso machine schedule is updated in the calendar for tomorrow's deep clean at 5pm. Don't schedule scone warmings then. :laughing:
Maya: Leaving now. If I don't respond it's because I'm in the kombucha aisle. :running_man: Back in ~35.
Devon: Legendary. Bring the oat milk and I'll claim label duty tomorrow.
Priya: Thanks! :thumbsup:
Maya: (post-run) Maya: Back — 3 bottles kombucha (ginger ran out so got lemon), almond scone, oat milk, labels, small containers, and the jar was indeed chutney. Left a sticky: "Ravi claims chutney 3/22". Receipts in #finance-ops.
Ravi: Nice rescue mission, thank you! I'll put the chutney in my locker at lunch. :handshake:
Sam: Scone disappears within 2 minutes. Worth it. :cry-laughing:
kitchen-bot: Note saved: new labels placed near the marker box.
Maya: Cool, closing the snack opera. If anyone wants to add to the snack fund please use /snack add. Peace.
